firstPlayerRule: Cut for the deal; the low card deals first. Play begins with the player to the left of the dealer.
houseFallback: If players cut the same low card, cut again.
internalEvidence: Fetched the Winning Moves-hosted rules PDF listed on winning-moves.com/rules/ and extracted its text with pdftotext. PDF page 2: "Cut for the deal. Low card deals first." "Players take turns, beginning with the player seated to the left of the dealer."
uncertainty: No tie-break is stated for equal low cuts.
